gpu5_sharing_amendment: 2026-09-20 user permits flexible GPU 5 sharing with their other project, including the last available authorized card; GPU 0 authorization withdrawn. No dummy reservation job. Require >=50000 MiB free and <=10% utilization immediately before loading; do not signal the other project.
closed_loop_budget_accounting: reserve both complete arm manifests before either evaluator process; charges never auto-refund on errors or missing records; recorded attempts are reported separately

development.sampling_rule: fixed evenly spaced heads/depths, all denoising steps; no ranking by observed importance

diagnostic_study.role: two historically exposed middle-trajectory observations; finite counterfactual screening
diagnostic_study.design: primary 7 selectors x 3 scopes; secondary 4 x 2 scopes; uniform/dynamic at two endpoints x 2 scopes; 3 selectors x replacement/recompute in AV; bottom dynamic and value-norm controls x AV/VV. Two fresh native reference calls, no extra warmup or automatic expansion.
diagnostic_study.location_rule: central sampled cell plus early/shallow and final/deep endpoints, frozen before observing intervention outcomes; these joint depth/time endpoints do not independently identify a depth or time effect
diagnostic_study.interpretation: Dense-derived indices are offline diagnostic targets only. Compare within operation/scope/input/location. Dynamic observed-frame scores are all zero; retained ties are explicit. No speed/SR or semantic-label claim.

online_screen.role: historically exposed development observations, already used for diagnostic screening
online_screen.gpu: H100 GPU 5 with fresh explicit sharing admission before each stage
online_screen.numerical_gate: bitwise executable AND raw pre-binarization actions against each variant's own eager reference on every graph call
launch_gates: four actual BF16 CUDA graph cases
online_screen.weight_calibration: compare dynamic fractions 0.25/0.5/0.75 plus pure endpoints with identical observed-frame uniform treatment; no fusion chosen by default
online_screen.scope: D0/R1-9 feature schedules; separate explicit Sparse refresh scan and structure comparisons follow after this bounded screen

confirmation.use: one frozen candidate after development; no tuning or threshold calibration on these identities
confirmation.historical_exposure_audit: must recheck before calling any future run confirmation

launch_gates: CPU and actual CUDA graph checks

experiment_matrix.limit: 47 frozen diagnostic cases plus 2 native controls; no automatic extension

experiment_matrix.comparison: fine dynamic + pooled background versus equal packed-budget hard selection

experiment_matrix.adaptive: optional; calibrate and freeze before use

experiment_matrix.scope: complete predict_action including every online cost; common backend and prompt cache; balanced/interleaved controls
